functions.name: add-member-to-team
functions.description: Add one existing domain user to a team without replacing its other members.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_addmembertoteam.description: One existing domain user and the team to add them to.

teamId.description: Team ID targeted by the accepted association change.

userId.description: User ID targeted by the accepted association change.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_addmembertotea.description: The team and user targeted by the accepted membership addition.

tags.instructions: Get teamId from `list-teams` and userId from `list-users`. Requires an Enterprise-domain service account. Use `update-team` for a complete desired member set and `remove-member-from-team` to remove an association. This does not create a user.

functions.name: create-enum-option
functions.description: Create a selectable enum option on a custom field, optionally placing it before or after an existing option.

name.description: Label for the new option, as ordinary text.

color.description: Provider color name; omitted to use the documented default none.

position.description: Optional relative position; omission appends the option.

relation.description: Place before or after the referenced existing option.

relativeToOptionId.description: Existing sibling option ID in the same custom field.

customFieldId.description: Custom-field ID receiving the enum option.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_createenumoptio.description: Custom field, option label, and optional color and relative position for a new enum option.

id.description: New enum-option ID returned by the provider.

enabled.description: Whether selectable; documented as true on creation when returned.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_createenumopti.description: Created enum-option identity and any returned option attributes.

tags.instructions: Obtain a customFieldId and optional sibling option ID from the field's definition; team-applied fields are available through `get-team-details`. New options are enabled and default to the end. A field supports no more than 500 options. Use `update-enum-option` for an existing option and `reorder-enum-option` to reposition one. Options cannot be deleted.

functions.name: create-team
functions.description: Create a domain team with an optional initial set of member user IDs.

name.description: Unique display name for the new team.

memberIds.description: Initial member user IDs; omission uses provider behavior, while [] explicitly requests no initial members.

items.description: Initial member user ID.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_createteam.description: Name and optional initial members of the new domain team.

id.description: ID of the team returned by the provider.

tags.instructions: Requires an Enterprise-domain service account. Get member IDs from `list-users`. Use `list-teams` to check a name before creation and `update-team` for an existing team. On an uncertain result, inspect teams before retrying.

functions.name: deprovision-user
functions.description: Deprovision (zombify) a domain user in Asana. This is account deprovisioning, not a promise of permanent content deletion.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_deprovisionuser.description: The domain user to deprovision in Asana.

userId.description: ID targeted by the accepted deprovisioning operation.

deprovisioned.description: The provider accepted deprovisioning; this does not establish permanent content deletion.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_deprovisionuse.description: Accepted account deprovisioning, without a guarantee of permanent content deletion.

tags.instructions: Get the user ID from `list-users`. Requires an Enterprise-domain service account. This removes the user's active provisioning; content deletion and reversibility are not established. Use `update-user` for profile changes. Check `get-user` or the Admin Console before repeating an uncertain request.

functions.name: get-service-provider-config
functions.description: Get the SCIM service's advertised protocol features, limits and authentication scheme metadata.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_getserviceprovi.description: No input is needed to read the service provider configuration.

bulk.description: Advertised SCIM bulk feature and limits, not an integration batch promise.

supported.description: Whether bulk requests are advertised as supported.

maxOperations.description: Advertised maximum operations per bulk request.

filter.description: Advertised filter feature and result limit.

supported.description: Whether filtering is advertised as supported.

etagSupported.description: Whether ETags are advertised as supported.

sortSupported.description: Whether sorting is advertised as supported.

patchSupported.description: Whether PATCH is advertised as supported.

authenticationSchemes.description: Advertised authentication methods; contains no credentials.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary advertised scheme.

items.description: Metadata for one advertised authentication scheme.

changePasswordSupported.description: Whether changing passwords is advertised as supported.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_getserviceprov.description: Advertised SCIM protocol capabilities, limits, and authentication scheme metadata.

tags.instructions: Use for provisioning compatibility checks. Requires an Enterprise-domain service account. Use `list-resource-types` and `list-schemas` for resource and attribute definitions. Returned feature flags describe provider metadata, not extra callable operations in this integration.

functions.name: get-team
functions.description: Get a domain team's provisioning name and membership by ID, including private teams accessible through SCIM.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_getteam.description: Identify the domain team to retrieve.

memberIds.description: User IDs of members when provided; omitted membership is unknown, not empty.

items.description: A team member user ID.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_getteam.description: The team provisioning name and membership when returned by SCIM.

tags.instructions: Get teamId from `list-teams`. Requires an Enterprise-domain service account. Use `get-team-details` instead for visibility, descriptions, policy settings and custom-field options.

functions.name: get-team-details
functions.description: Get a team's descriptions, visibility, administrative policies and custom-field settings through the standard Asana team API.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_getteamdetails.description: Reference to the Asana team whose details to retrieve.

policies.description: Administrative access policies, omitted individually if unavailable.

manageContent.description: Who may create and share team content.

manageGuestInvites.description: Who may accept or deny guest invitations.

manageJoinRequests.description: Who may accept or deny membership requests.

manageMemberInvites.description: Who may accept or deny member invitations.

editNameOrDescription.description: Who may edit the name or description.

editVisibilityOrTrash.description: Who may change visibility or trash the team.

permalinkUrl.description: URL of the team in Asana.

htmlDescription.description: Formatted team description as original HTML, when returned.

customFieldSettings.description: Custom-field associations and definitions applied to this team.

parentId.description: Container ID to which the custom field is applied.

customField.description: Custom-field definition relevant to interpreting and managing options.

enumOptions.description: Ordered enum options, including disabled options when returned.

items.description: An enum-option definition in provider order.

resourceSubtype.description: Provider custom-field subtype, such as enum or multi_enum.

isImportant.description: Whether the setting is prominent in list/grid views.

items.description: A custom-field association applied to the team.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_getteamdetails.description: Team descriptions, visibility, administrative policies and custom-field definitions.

tags.instructions: Use a team ID from `list-teams` or an existing Asana team reference. Requires teams:read. Use `get-team` for SCIM provisioning membership instead. Returned custom-field and enum-option IDs can be used by the enum-option tools. This call does not change policy settings.

functions.name: get-user
functions.description: Get a domain user's identity, profile, licensing and enterprise attributes by ID. Guests are not included.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_getuser.description: Identify the domain user to retrieve.

givenName.description: Given name, without inference from display name.

name.description: Name components as returned by Asana.

active.description: Whether the account is active, if returned.

items.description: An email entry as returned by Asana.
An opaque role ID.

licenses.description: Assigned license names in provider order; empty string is represented as an empty array.

A postal location entry.

division.description: Organizational division metadata, not licensing division.

enterprise.description: Enterprise extension metadata; omitted if not supplied.

items.description: A phone entry as returned by Asana.

licensingDivisionId.description: Opaque licensing subdivision or parent-domain ID.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_getuser.description: A domain user with identity, profile, licensing and enterprise attributes, without a SCIM envelope.

tags.instructions: Use a user ID from `list-users`; use `list-users` with userName when only an email is known. Requires an Enterprise-domain service account. This does not reactivate or modify the user.

functions.name: list-resource-types
functions.description: List the SCIM resource types and their endpoint/schema declarations for provisioning discovery.

schemaId.description: Primary schema URI identifying this resource type.

Resource type declarations returned by this discovery request.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_listresourcety.description: One collection of SCIM resource-type discovery metadata.

tags.instructions: Use for SCIM integration discovery, not to list users or teams. Requires an Enterprise-domain service account. Use `list-schemas` for attribute definitions and `get-service-provider-config` for supported protocol features. Returns one metadata collection.

functions.description: List SCIM schema definitions and their typed attribute constraints for provisioning discovery.

functions.description: List one page of domain users, excluding guests, optionally matching an exact login email.

limit.description: Requested users per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 50.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from the preceding result; reuse with the same filter and limit.

userName.description: Exact login email to match; omit to enumerate domain users.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_listusers.description: Options for one page of domain users, optionally filtered by exact login email.

name.description: Name components provided by Asana; omitted components remain absent.

emails.description: Email addresses, retaining provider order and primary indicators.

roleIds.description: Opaque RBAC role IDs from roles[].value.

licenses.description: Assigned license names in provider-reported alphabetical order; an empty upstream string becomes an empty array.

functions.name: remove-member-from-team
functions.description: Remove one user's association with a team while preserving the team and its other members.

teamId.description: Team whose member association is removed.

userId.description: User ID to remove from this team only.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_removememberfro.description: The team and user association to remove.

teamId.description: Team whose membership change was accepted.

userId.description: User whose association was targeted for removal.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_removememberfr.description: Receipt for the removed or already absent team association.

tags.instructions: Get teamId from `list-teams` and inspect membership with `get-team`. Requires an Enterprise-domain service account. This removes only team membership, not the user account or team. Use `deprovision-user` to deprovision an account, or `update-team` to replace the full member set.

functions.name: reorder-enum-option
functions.description: Reposition an existing enum option before or after another option in the same custom field's ordered list.

relation.description: Place the moved option before or after its sibling.

relativeToOptionId.description: Sibling option ID, distinct from the moved option.

position.description: Desired relative position within the same field.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_reorderenumopti.description: Identify an existing custom-field option and its desired position relative to a sibling.

enumOptionId.description: Existing option targeted by the ordering change.

customFieldId.description: Field whose option ordering change was accepted.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_reorderenumopt.description: Identifiers for the accepted enum-option ordering change, without a complete ordered list.

tags.instructions: Obtain the field ID, option ID and sibling option ID from the field definition or `get-team-details`. All options must belong to the same field. This changes order, not membership, identity or selectability. Use `update-enum-option` for label/color/enabled changes and `create-enum-option` for a new option.

functions.name: replace-team
functions.description: Replace a team's SCIM-managed name and complete membership using explicit desired values.

teamId.description: Existing team ID; identity is retained.

items.description: User ID of a desired team member.

memberIds.description: Complete desired membership; [] removes all existing members.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_replaceteam.description: Explicit desired name and complete membership of an existing team.

id.description: ID of the existing team whose replacement was accepted.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_replaceteam.description: Identity of the existing team after its replacement was accepted.

tags.instructions: Use for deliberate full provisioning replacement, not an incremental membership edit. Get teamId from `list-teams` and member IDs from `list-users`. Requires an Enterprise-domain service account. All existing members not supplied are removed; [] removes everyone. Use `update-team` to preserve omitted attributes.

functions.name: update-enum-option
functions.description: Partially update an enum option's label, color or selectability. Disabling prevents new selection but retains values already set on tasks.

name.description: Replacement label; omitted to preserve the current label.

color.description: Replacement provider color name; use none to remove color, omit to preserve it.

enabled.description: Whether selectable for new values; false retains existing task assignments, omission preserves current selectability.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_updateenumoptio.description: An enum option ID and at least one label, color or selectability change.

id.description: ID of the option whose update was accepted.

name.description: Stored label if returned by the provider.

color.description: Stored color if returned by the provider.

enabled.description: Stored selectability if returned by the provider.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_updateenumopti.description: The updated option identity and stored attributes returned by Asana.

tags.instructions: Use an option ID from the custom-field definition or `get-team-details`. Omitted fields are unchanged. enabled=false disables the option without deleting it or clearing existing task values; enabled=true requests re-enabling. Use `reorder-enum-option` for position and `create-enum-option` for a new option. Options cannot be deleted.

functions.name: update-team
functions.description: Partially update a team's name or replace its member set while preserving omitted attributes.

name.description: Replacement unique display name; omission preserves it.

memberIds.description: Complete desired member set; omission preserves membership, [] removes all members.

items.description: Opaque user ID to include in the desired member set.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_updateteam.description: Partially update a team by supplying a replacement name, a complete member set, or both.

id.description: Team ID whose update was accepted.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_updateteam.description: Identity of the team whose update was accepted.

tags.instructions: Get teamId from `list-teams` and member IDs from `list-users`. Requires an Enterprise-domain service account. memberIds replaces the whole member set; use `add-member-to-team` or `remove-member-from-team` for one association. Use `replace-team` when deliberately supplying all provisioning attributes. Empty memberIds removes every member.

functions.name: update-user
functions.description: Partially update a domain user's profile and administrative assignments, including explicit attribute clearing and account activity changes.

name.description: Name components to update; omitted components are preserved.

formatted.description: Full display name; empty string assigns an empty value rather than an explicit removal.

givenName.description: Given name; implemented through PUT because PATCH does not support this component.

familyName.description: Family name; implemented through PUT because PATCH does not support this component.

title.description: Replacement job title; empty string remains an explicit empty assignment.

active.description: false deprovisions the account; true requests activation, subject to provider state rules.

emails.description: Complete replacement email list; [] clears it if permitted.

primary.description: Whether primary; at most one may be true.

roleIds.description: Complete replacement RBAC role IDs; [] removes roles if permitted.

licenses.description: Complete replacement licenses; [] requests no licenses.

addresses.description: Complete replacement postal locations; [] clears them.

enterprise.description: Enterprise metadata updates; omitted siblings are preserved.

division.description: Organizational division metadata, not billing division.

phoneNumbers.description: Complete replacement phone numbers; [] clears them.

licensingDivisionId.description: Licensing subdivision GID; use the domain GID to move back to parent billing.

changes.description: Fields to assign; omitted fields are preserved. Arrays replace that field's complete collection.

clearFields.description: Attributes to remove, not assign null; must not overlap changes. Omission clears nothing.

FunctionInput_asana_scim_updateuser.description: Partially assign or explicitly clear profile and administrative attributes of one domain user.

id.description: User ID whose update the provider accepted; read get-user for resulting attributes.

FunctionOutput_asana_scim_updateuser.description: Identity of the user whose update was accepted, not a snapshot of the resulting profile.

tags.instructions: Get the user ID from `list-users`. Requires an Enterprise-domain service account. Omitted fields are preserved; clearFields explicitly removes supported attributes. active=false deprovisions the user; use `deprovision-user` for that task alone. Role IDs come from Admin Console. Use `get-user` to inspect the result, especially before retrying an uncertain write.
